self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Sky-ripping Dragon Spine (R1): after using Elemental Burst, Normal or Charged Attack hits create a vacuum blade dealing 80% of ATK as DMG (lasts 20s or 8 blades). Modeled as a supplementary hit of 80% ATK — its own rotation target (weapon/normalExtraHit + weapon/chargedExtraHit), weight = how many blades land while active (max 8); physical, scales with ATK and CRIT only, no DMG% bonuses. Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: A claymore that symbolizes the pride of Dvalin soaring through the skies. When swung, it emits a deep hum as the full force of Dvalin's command of the sky and the wind is unleashed.

refinements.1: Increases all DMG by <r>8%</r>. After using an Elemental Burst, a vacuum blade that does <r>80%</r> of ATK as DMG to opponents along its path will be created when Normal or Charged Attacks hit. Lasts for 20s or 8 vacuum blades.

fr.flavor: Une épée à deux mains symbolisant le fier envol de Dvalin dans les cieux. Elle émet un son grave lorsqu'on la brandit, invoquant la puissance du dragon Anémo qui déchaîne les vents.

passive.name: Échine du dragon briseur de ciel

refinements.1: Augmente tous les DGT infligés de <r>8 %</r>. Après un déchaînement élémentaire, les attaques normales et chargées génèrent une lame de vide qui inflige <r>80 %</r> de DGT d'ATQ aux ennemis sur sa route. Cet effet dure 20 s ou 8 lames.
